chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali ibn Shajara, from Bashir al-Nabbal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you are granted success in something, persist in it.

key_terms.رُزِقْتَ: You are granted success or grace
key_terms.فَالْزَمْهُ: So persist in it / hold fast to it

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic advice for maintaining success in a beneficial endeavor?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) advises steadfastness in beneficial endeavors, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on *istiqamah* (consistency) as a means to consolidate divine blessings (*rizq*). This principle underscores that spiritual and material success is often sustained not by novelty, but by persistent adherence to what is already proven beneficial, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt.
